text: Steenbarger: nothing on the slate answers minervini's WAIT or the volume test; ACT_NOW on h1_close_above:bar_high should not stand. My method agrees on WAIT for its own reason: FROG is a RETRACEMENT (C2) at close_vs_swing_high_pct 6.96, D HH but LL, so I buy only the pullback. Volume is oneil/minervini/wyckoff's test, not mine; day_vol 0.88 is my range proxy only (R5). Clears with reclaim:structure_shift_ref on H1, wrong if a daily close below structure_shift_ref (C17, C20). A volume clause on that reclaim bar I would not oppose. Name SUPPORT, trigger WAIT.
